spec2def(bthci.dll bthci.spec)

# bthci.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/bthci-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(bthci_shims OBJECT bthci.c)
target_link_libraries(bthci_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(bthci_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(bthci bthci-cargo bthci.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS bthci_shims psdk)
